content.thinking:
I'll write the whole file in one pass, keeping the API usage conservative. I'm designing a gray wolf standing alert at roughly 0.85m shoulder height and 1.4m body length, facing +Z, with a chunky Blizzard-style look featuring oversized paws, head and shoulders, painted gradients, and worn accents like a tribal charm necklace or riveted leather strap.

Now I'm planning the actual build: lofting the body along the z-axis using stations for the hips-to-chest profile, using capsule sweeps for the legs since they're more reliable, and setting up custom coat paint combining countershading, mottling, gradients, and grain for a natural gray-cream fur look. I'm working out specific coordinates and radii for the front legs, paws, and hind leg thighs and hocks to get proportions that touch the ground correctly and read as chunky and sturdy.

Now I'm continuing down to the hind paws, then building up the neck capsule, skull sphere, muzzle, nose, mouth line, spike-shaped ears with lighter inner spikes, and small glowing amber eye spheres with pupils -- working out positions, scales, and radii for each head feature.

For the fur details I'm planning dark brow rods and a ruff of scattered spikes around the neck using deterministic randomization instead of fur cards. I'm also sketching the tail as a swept catmull-rom path with a bushy radius profile and dark banded tip, plus shoulder and spine ruff tufts using more spike placement along the back.

Now I'm adding a collar: a torus strap oriented along the neck axis with gold rivet spheres computed from perpendicular ring vectors, a hanging bone-fang pendant charm, and finally pale claw spikes with dark toe lines on the paws.

Setting up a mirrored-leg helper and limiting the overall palette before working on body coloring: a countershaded mottled gray-brown coat blending into cream, with a custom paint function tanning the lower legs based on vertical position.

Adding fur tuft generation around the neck ruff...

Setting hackle height around 0.82 along the spine, buried slightly at the base. Adding haunch muscle spheres near the hips and shoulder blade spheres near the shoulders for a chunkier build, then moving on to write everything out.
